selected.label: Cozonac
selected.rationale: Concrete familiar sweet bread; usor salience .9737. All 24 incoming associations inspected. Specific flour and walnut routes now give rank2 hot; dessert5 and cacao16 hot, yeast28/sugar26 warm, egg38 warm. Exact noun and cozonacul/cozonaci/cozonacii win. Unt rank504 cold remains; aluat, stafide, rahat, vanilie and holiday surfaces Paște/Crăciun unresolved. Nut/flour blockers are materially repaired, but the omitted ingredient vocabulary must remain disclosed. Existing broad celebration links do not justify claiming perfect holiday-word coverage.

selected.label: Pască
selected.rationale: Concrete familiar Easter cheese pastry; normal salience .72. All five incoming associations inspected: Cozonac, Masa de Paște, Ouă roșii, Brânză, Desert. Brânză rank5/desert3/făină9 hot, ou/ouă16 and lapte34 warm. Pască, pasca and pasca cu branza win. Paște/Crăciun, stafide and păști unresolved; butter/nut/miere/gem cold. Cheese, egg and pastry approaches form a coherent route despite unresolved holiday input and optional additions; normal remains a conservative editorial choice.

selected.label: Muștar

selected.label: Mujdei
selected.rationale: Concrete familiar garlic sauce; usor salience .7993. All eleven incoming associations inspected. Defining usturoi rank2 and sos3 hot; grătar7 and ciorbă10 hot; apă39 and salt27 warm. Mujdei, mujdeiul and mujdei de usturoi win. Pește rank441 cold, oil1177/lemon1281 very cold. selected.label: Ciorbă de burtă
selected.rationale: Concrete widely known tripe soup; normal salience .8739. All seven incoming associations inspected. Ciorbă rank2, oțet10 and usturoi11 hot; smântână19 warm. Exact/diacriticless and ciorbei de burtă forms win. The defining ingredient burtă originally gave four hops/rank434/Rece through the body projection. V82 now supplies an explicitly reviewed target-only association: the same synthetic Burtă identity gives one hop/rank2/Fierbinte without winning, while the exact soup phrase is still required to finish. The same764 API observations were rerun on final runtime: only this one changed, with all other763 exact. The separate full-KG boundary tests are needed to prove every other target retains the body meaning, and direct-neighbor traversal must stay disabled. This repairs the central ingredient contradiction within the same batch. Existing description references long parties but the proposed round depends on a familiar dish and ingredient recognition, not alcohol/adult framing; A5 still receives independent scrutiny. Keep here means pending staging only, with final dossier-bound analyst/adversarial review required.
